title: With All Your Might! Take a Full-Throttle Break!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
I need you to hang out with me on our next day off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Bamboo Memory asked me with such earnest formality,
we met up later and headed to—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this!
—We are going to unwind like normal students DOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Do you remember those two students
we caught hanging around outside the arcade late at night?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
"We run from morning till night, and then we're told to do solo training on our days off!
Is it really so wrong to want to take a breather once in a while!?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She had a point. I've only ever focused on cracking down on rule-breakers.
Just now, and every time before that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I decided to put that 'meeting them halfway' advice
you gave me into practice!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I investigate what kinds of 'relaxing' are popular with kids these days,
I'll be able to understand their mindset, right?!
choice_data_list: That's very thoughtful of you, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
It's only natural for the Head of the Disciplinary Committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's try out this trendy lipstick right away—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WHA—!? A shade this dark is completely unacceptable!
It's a total violation of school dress code!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, our "relaxation" investigation with Bamboo Memory
got underway, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: T-This is "Memories of the Madonna"...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was told it was a 'mature romance movie,'
but what on earth was THAT!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nobody warned me there'd be scenes that completely undermine public decency!
That's way too stimulating for young folks!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A-A couple's drink—!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Two people sharing one single beverage...
Is this really what people do to relax!?
choice_data_list: You say that, but you're still ordering it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's all for research!
Come on, Trainer, drink up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we checked out hot spots popular with the youth
and tried out trendy entertainment, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is research, you know! The goal is to learn how to unwind!
Having fun is strictly secondary!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, hmph... I get the trendy makeup and movies now,
but I still don't understand how those girls feel.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Does this mean I'm still not meeting them halfway?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's so caught up in the idea of "research" that
I feel like she's completely missing the essence of taking a break...
choice_data_list: If you're unwinding, you've gotta enjoy it from the bottom of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: From the bottom of my heart, you say?
choice_data_list: Let's play with everything we've got!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait!?
Where are we goooing?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see...
So playing games like this helps people unwind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after trying out popular games, Bamboo Memory still
doesn't seem fully immersed. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Kendo Blade"?
Whoa, a game where you duel with kendo?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Up key for Men, left/right keys for Do—I see!
This looks exciting! Let's have a good match!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, I lost~?!
What was that smokescreen just now?! I couldn't see a single thing!!
choice_data_list: It's a skill used to disrupt your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing in kendo!
That's a foul! Total foul!!
choice_data_list: Using all sorts of skills is part of the rules.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...
Rules... so it's all about rules, huh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Then by those very rules, I'm gonna win next time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gahhh?!
O-One more! Just one more game, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... One more time!
I swear I'm gonna see through your moves next round...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—NOW'S MY CHANCE!!
MEEEEN!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, all right—!!
Did you see that?! Check out my skill handling!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Even in a video game, I won't lose when it comes to kendo!!
choice_data_list: If it's not a kendo game, I'll definitely win!
If it's not a kendo game, I'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you never know till you try!
Let's settle it on that game over there first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, I'm completely wiped out!
It's been forever since I played this hard...
choice_data_list: How did it feel playing with everything you had?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, it was an absolute blast.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It felt so refreshing and exhilarating.
Before I knew it, I was so pumped that I forgot all about the patrol—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It felt just like scoring an ippon in a kendo match!
...I think I finally understand how those girls felt.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on the other day...
I might've been way too harsh on them after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Races and training are important, but blowing off steam and having fun
might've been just as important to them...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to realize that today.
I'm super grateful!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I... want to try talking to those girls one more time.
Even if I might mess up again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh,
hearing you say that really gives me courage!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's play together again sometime!
Next time too... we go all out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having learned a valuable lesson in her own way,
Bamboo Memory wore a bright, radiant smile.
